subject: [PATCH 26/60] mm/migrate: leave pages outside common memory in move_pages()

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the move_pages() function by leaving pages outside common memory where they are, similar to ZONE_DEVICE pages. The change involves modifying the __add_folio_for_migration() function to check if a page is in common memory before attempting to move it.
